newsitem.title: CANADA: CBRS raises Nova Scotia rating outlook to stable.
newsitem.headline: CBRS raises Nova Scotia rating outlook to stable.

text.p: Canadian Bond Rating Service said it reaffirmed Nova Scotia's long- and short-term debt ratings on Wednesday and raised the outlook on the province's paper to stable from negative.
"After a slower than expected 1996, Nova Scotia's real GDP is forecast to increase by 1.6 percent and 1.5 percent in 1997 and 1998 respectively," CBRS said.
The province's Sable Gas project, which is close to receiving final approval, also is expected to provide between C$600 million (US$436.7 million) and C$1 billion (US$727.8 million), CBRS said.
CBRS also cited Nova Scotia's small government surpluses and modest tax reductions as further reasons for the ratings change.
